worked_solution:
If a particle moves with constant acceleration $a,$ the position vector of the particle at time $t$ can be found using

$$
r={r}_{0}+ut+\frac{1}{2}a{t}^{2},
$$

where ${r}_{0}$ is the initial position of the particle and $u$ is its initial velocity.

In our case, we have

$$
{r}_{0}=3i+2j,\,u=i-j,\,a=2i+j.
$$

Therefore, the position vector of the parcel robot after $t=3\,\text{s}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =(3i+2j)+(i-j)(3)+\frac{1}{2}(2i+j)(3)^{2} \\  & =(3i+2j)+(i-j)(3)+\frac{1}{2}(18i+9j) \\  & =(3i+2j)+(3i-3j)+(9i+4.5j) \\  & =(\,15\,i+3.5\,j)\,\text{cm}.\end{aligned}
$$
